_comment: wq#2273 (T4): forge + token-file map the daemon consults per repo slug. The CLIENT never names a base URL or token file — only this root-installed file does. Token files are basenames inside /var/lib/token-engine/secrets; identity_map is lumen-github-identity.sh's per-repo map (only the basename of a mapped path is honoured).
_comment_t1: wq#2271 (T1): github_git_url/gitea_git_username serve the git-credential/git-fetch/git-push verbs. Adding a github_app block {app_id, installation_id, private_key_file} switches GitHub git auth from the engine-held PAT to per-call 1h App installation tokens (T0 prereq: no App installed yet).
